lines.en: I knock on Futaba's door and wait for her to answer.
I figure with the amount of time I've spent at the library lately (As well as her not-so-hidden affinity for me), getting into her room shouldn't be all that hard.
But hey, she's a teenage girl and...girls can be territorial when it comes to their rooms or something. Probably.
I don't really know. Ami isn't like that at all, but Ami is also proving to be a...special sort of case thus far.
: Umm...hello?
: Hey, Futaba, are you in there right now?
: Sensei? I'm sorry, I had no idea you were coming. Is something wrong?
: Nope. Just dropping by to see how you’re doing. Mind coming out for a second?
: Of course! I'll be right out!
I take a step back and wait for Futaba to- oh. Nevermind. She's already here.
: Umm...hi. Is there...something I can do for you?
: Yes, actually. Can I borrow 1000 yen?
: I...suppose. But can I...ask why you need to borrow money from me?
: Futaba, no. Don't just agree to lending me money like that. I was only messing around.
: H-How was I supposed to know that? You've never visited me in my room before. I thought this might be some sort of emergency.
: The only emergency here is my boredom.
: Or something.
: Anyway, what are you up to?
: Just reading...like always.
: You're lucky you knocked at a good stopping point. Otherwise, I probably wouldn't have even answered...
: You did sound a little confused answering the door. Do you not normally get visitors or something?
: Not ones that knock, at least...Most people just walk in.
: Well, I'll make sure to follow proper protocol next time and just open the door without running it by you first.
: Please don't ever do that at any point ever. I would die.
: I'm more than happy to invite you in so long as I...actually know you're coming and-
: Cool. Let me in, then.
: Right now? Are you serious?
: Sure. It's my duty as your teacher to make sure your...dorm room is conducive to proper...educational...learning stuff?
: Does that sound like something a teacher would say?
: That doesn't sound like something anyone would say...why are you acting so strangely all of a sudden?
: Is wanting to be alone with you inside of your room really that strange?
: Well...maybe strange was the wrong word to use. It's just...entirely unexpected.
: But I guess if it's just to...make sure my room is conducive to proper...educational...learning stuff...it's okay?
: There's not really...much to show you, though...so I doubt you'll have any fun.
: Just being with you is fun enough for me, Futaba.
: Umm...this might be a bit of a silly question, but...this isn't some sort of prank, is it?
: Did...someone put you up to this? Or...is there some sort of catch I don't know about yet?...
: No. Why would you even assume that?
: It's just that...this all seems a little too good to be true. That's all.
: W-W-W-W-Which doesn't mean that I've actually ever thought about something like this happening, of course!
: I just mean that in a...hypothetical situation where...I had been dreaming about something like that...then this would be too good to be true.
: But as it stands, it's just...it's just normal good.
: Futaba.
: Yes, I'm sorry. Please follow me in, Sensei...but again, don't expect too much...
: So, umm, here we are...my completely unexciting bedroom...
: I'm going to go ahead and assume this the first time you’ve had a guy in your room?
: The only other guy I know is my dad, so...
: There's no way that is the only other male you know.
: Boys, umm...weren't really interested in me in middle school...so I mostly just...flew under the radar.
: Way under the radar.
: And while I like attending an all-girls school for...completely unrelated reasons...it hasn’t really helped prepare me for situations like this...
: No secret online boyfriends or anything either?
: Not that I'm aware of...
: There was one...umm...person on a message board I used to visit, but...that was a...kind of...roleplaying thing, so...
: W-Why am I even telling you about that when you...obviously don't want to hear any of it.
: You’re just...here to look at the room...right, Sensei? For the...learning...education thing?
: You probably don't even know what roleplay is and...uhh...
: Can you please say something to prevent me from rambling and revealing any more embarrassing secrets?
: I guess, but I was kind of interested in hearing where that was going.
: I don't even know...how I would have started in explaining it, so...it's probably best if we just move on and forget any of the last two minutes ever happened.
I scan Futaba’s side of the room and I'm not able to really learn anything new about her other than that she's a bit neater and more organized than Rin.
There’s a quote from Edgar Allan Poe on her dry erase board, which is...sort of surprising since she doesn't seem like the type to indulge in gothic poetry...
But I guess I don't really seem like that type of person either and I don't have any problems with him.
Dying alone, drunk, and probably rabid is a pretty memorable way to go out, all things considered.
: So, umm...this is where I do all of my school work and...all of my writing.
: When I'm...actually able to get any writing done, that is. Being creative is...kind of really hard and I wish I was better at it.
: Well, have you started writing anything for me yet? Because practicing is pretty much the only way you're going to get any better.
: I have, but....it’s not very good.
: Can I see it? Or are you going to make me wait until it's more up to your standards?
: I-Ignoring how low my standards are...please wait a little longer!
: I've...barely even started! I need more time to...build the world and...the characters and...
: The plot...
: How much have you gotten done, exactly?
: The...
: The title?...
: Wow.
: Being creative is...really hard...
: Hey, I told you before right? I’ll help you with whatever you need help with.
: I know, I know...It’s just really embarrassing.
: Like...if it’s not good enough, I'm worried you’ll think I’m a loser and...want to give up on me or something.
: Futaba, you’re one of the brightest girls I know.
Probably.
: Plus, aren’t we supposed to be friends now? Or were you not paying attention in class when I said that?
: I was definitely paying attention!
: I’m just still getting used to thinking of you as more than my teacher...
: Up until recently, I...had no idea a friendship with you was even possible...
: Is there...anything I can do to make the process a little easier?
: To...make it easier?
: Yeah. Like something friends would do, but not a teacher and a student?
: Not...anything that wouldn't make me sound really weird for suggesting it...
: Well, that certainly sounded suggestive. Are you flirting with me, Futaba?
: N-N-N-N-No! I would never suggest anything like that with you, Sensei!
: Well, that just hurts.
: Not that I don't find you attractive! I do! It's just that I respect you as a teacher and would never want to jeopardize our relationship and...uhh...
: Uhhh!
: Deep breaths, Futaba. Now, what were you going to suggest we do in a completely platonic, non-flirtatious manner that will still somehow make you sound weird?
: Just that...we maybe...I don't know...hug or something?
: Oh. Easy.
: Ah! Sensei! W-W-W-what are you doing?
: You literally just suggested this.
: I didn't think you'd just grab me! I didn't even have time to prepare!
: How do you prepare for a hug?...
: I have no idea! My mind is going a million miles an hour right now.
: And I...I think something hard is pushing up against me?
: That’s just the feeling of my desire for you to succeed.
: Your what?
: Nevermind that. The point is, we're friends now and, according to you, friends hug each other.
: I don't really have any friends, so this is news to me.
: Please don't just casually say super depressing things like that. They'll confuse me even more.
: You're going to have to get used to that side of me, Futaba. It is never going away.
: This is...all happening so fast.
: I guess. But hey, you're not trying to pull away, so I must be doing something right.
: Well...That’s just...
: Just what?
: Ugh...you’re right. I honestly like this a lot...
: I knew it. You were flirting with me.
: No...I just like hugs.
: And I...
: I also...
: I also like-
: Ah-
: Sorry. I should take this.
: Hello?
: Hi, Sensei!
: Hey. Did you need something?
: Hm? No. Not really.
: So what?
: So why did you call?
: Oh!
: I just suddenly felt like you were about to do something that would make me sad. So I figured I'd let you hear my voice so you can remember I exist.
: Sensei? Are you still there?
: I'll talk to you later, Ami.
: Wait! Don't-
: Sorry about that. It was just Ami being overbearing again.
: She...really likes you, doesn't she?
: Yeah, well...I'm kind of all she has, so...
: Anyway, should we get back to the hugging now?
: Oh, umm...I think we've...done enough of that for today...
: I was actually just...thinking that I should probably...keep writing that story you asked me to write, so...
: So you're kicking me out?
: Can we think of it as me...politely asking you to leave?...
: I guess we can.
: But this is not the last you have hugged of me, Futaba.
: Now, goodbye.
I exit the room in dramatic fashion, leaving Futaba dumbfounded and impressed by my above average way with words.
On my way down the stairs, I silently curse at Ami to myself for ruining what could have been a huge step for Futaba and me.
But I immediately forgive her upon returning home and finding dinner waiting for me.
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
You can now spend time with her in her room!
